heading: UTP Patch Cord
bottomHtml:
High-Quality UTP Patch Cord – Reliable Ethernet Cable for Fast & Stable Connectivity

Ensure fast, stable, and interference-free data transmission with our premium UTP Patch Cord. Designed for high-performance networking, this unshielded twisted pair (UTP) Ethernet cable is ideal for connecting computers, switches, routers, and other network-enabled devices in both home and professional environments.

Key Features:

  • Category Options: Available in Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6a for Gigabit and high-speed networks.

  • High-Speed Data Transfer: Supports up to 1Gbps (Cat5e) and 10Gbps (Cat6a) speeds.

  • Reliable Construction: 100% copper conductors for superior signal quality and performance.

  • Flexible & Durable: PVC jacket ensures easy routing and long-lasting use.

  • Plug & Play: Pre-terminated with RJ45 connectors for quick, hassle-free installation.

Perfect for use in data centers, home networks, office setups, CCTV systems, and more. This UTP patch cord ensures consistent performance and minimal crosstalk, making it a trusted choice for professional and everyday users.
